source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: The bearer and every **BATTLELINE** model in its unit get 1 better Armour Penetration on their melee weapons. Only an **ADEPTUS ASTARTES** model may take it.

effects.appliesTo: melee weapons of the bearer and of BATTLELINE models in the bearer's unit

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Bastion Task Force Detachment; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
